it is possible to obtain better end-to-end performance using a simple joint modelling approach than the previous state-of-the-art approaches that used sophisticated joint modelling approaches.

a simple neural network based joint model can be used for end-to-end relation identification, without the need of complex inference or learning algorithms like MLNs or CRFs, and can be effectively used for relation extraction on real-world data.
